title: The matrix, for Kelwin
summary: The page's one paper moment: a page of the Narrative OS you would hold — the message matrix — filled in with Kelwin's own positioning, so it shows the real structure without a single client fact, with editor's marks on the columns and the two readings that explain a row per listener.
story: Answers “what do we actually walk away with?” by showing it. The strips said four services; this is the document they become. Each listener gets a row because the deal has many (the readings), and the one red underline marks the sentence a champion must be able to retell.
